product_summary: Company website (nitinspinners.com) lists exactly three product lines: (1) Yarns — 'spun yarns', positioned as an industry leader in spun yarn manufacturing; (2) Finished & Printed Fabrics — 'complete range of Dyed and Printed Fabrics made out of 100% Cotton and Blends for Fashion, Apparel and Wovens'; (3) Knitted Fabrics — greige knitted fabrics produced from in-house yarn. Company brief: established 1993, textile manufacturer. No food, FMCG, or non-textile products appear anywhere on the site.
comment: HS mapping: declared 5205.13/5205.14/5205.26 are cotton single yarn subheadings and are consistent with the 'Yarns / spun yarns' line — plausible but the site does not publish yarn counts, so exact subheading split (carded vs combed, single vs plied) is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and cannot be verified without a customs line. Declared 511290 is woven fabric of combed wool/wool blends: the site's fabric line is explicitly '100% Cotton and Blends' with no wool mentioned anywhere — this code is unsupported by the catalogue and should be treated as wrong/unverified unless a customs record shows wool-blend fabric. Conversely, the declaration omits the two lines the site does confirm: woven cotton fabrics (5208/5209) and knitted fabrics (6005/6006), which are a material share of the product range — product lines missing from the declaration. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong — this is a textile spinner/weaver (yarn, woven and knitted fabric), not food or FMCG; industry field must be corrected to textiles. No trader signs: own manufacturing units, own spinning/weaving/knitting infrastructure, listed company with investor-relations section — manufacturer, not trader. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, declared codes corrected to the actual textile range (5205 yarn, 5208/5209 woven cotton fabric, 6005/6006 knitted fabric), with 5112 flagged as unverified. All product facts sourced from nitinspinners.com product pages (Yarns, Finished & Printed Fabrics, Knitted Fabrics) and Company Brief; no customs/B-L line was available to me in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted.
